memories.text: The team's goal is to make a new remote control that is original, trendy, and user-friendly.
The selling price for the remote is 25 euro.
The profit aim for the project is 50 million euro.
Production cost must be a maximum of 1250 euro per remote.
Battery type and size is important to remember for the remote.

batch.summary: This kickoff meeting for a new remote control project opened with introductions and a fun icebreaker in which participants sketched and described their favorite animals. The team then set a goal of a trendy, user-friendly, original remote with a 25 euro selling price, a 50 million euro profit aim, and production costs capped at 1250 euro per remote, and brainstormed features such as multi-device compatibility, clear instructions, ergonomic design, and battery type (double or triple A versus a small lithium battery, undecided). Roles were assigned for individual work: industrial design, technical functions design, and marketing user requirements specification, with each person to work individually before reconvening. The next meeting is set to start in about 30 minutes, and participants will receive follow-up instructions by email.
